reports.description: A weak tornado was observed by multiple eyewitnesses near Lipnica Murowana during the passage of an isolated cell. The rating is preliminary. The time was estimated based on radar data.
references: Eyewitnesses reports via Pogoda Żegocina (on Facebook), 24 JUL 2026.
"Trąba powietrzna w okolicach Lipnicy Murowanej? Są nagrania – WIDEO", Bochnianin, 24 JUL 2026.
"Trąba powietrzna w Małopolsce? Nagranie pokazuje lej przy ziemi", Onet, 24 JUL 2026.
